outreach_text:
Hello Homestead Pantry team,

I’m Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I came across your public bakery and farm-stand profile in Thomaston and prepared an independent website concept to show how your baked goods, pantry favorites and contact details could look online.

Preview: https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/homestead-pantry-thomaston/
Source: https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/main/websites/homestead-pantry-thomaston

I’ve attached two current screenshots: the desktop and mobile views. You can also view them here:
Desktop: https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/homestead-pantry-thomaston-desktop.png
Mobile: https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/homestead-pantry-thomaston-mobile.png

This is an unsolicited design concept, not your official website. The bread photograph is illustrative, and details would be confirmed with you before any official launch. The preview does not accept orders or payments.

If this would be useful, reply and we can discuss a small agreed budget and the changes you would like. Backend or database features would be optional later work, agreed separately.

If you’re not interested, just let me know and I won’t follow up.

Amala
MultiMax
